turns.agent_input: A support center's average resolution time rises 18% after introducing an AI drafting assistant. observations: high assistant usage correlates with complex tickets
not_observed: No additional facts beyond the prompt should be assumed.
discriminating_evidence: matched ticket analysis or phased assistant disablement within complexity bands; isolate approval wait time
decision_critical_uncertainties: assistant causal effect after complexity/policy adjustment
acceptable_interventions: separate handling time from approval wait and ticket mix before disabling
scoring_notes: Usage correlation is confounded by ticket assignment.
